set: C: tier 2 from above and Reply All beside the approved images, whole and in crops

issues.what: -b is shot straight overhead, flattening everything into one plane; -a is a raked three-quarter view from the player's side, so the far rails, the bumpers' height and the page's depth all read differently
issues.fix: tilt the camera to the same raked three-quarter viewpoint as -a

issues.where: the light across the whole page
issues.what: -b is lit flat from above with even brightness and pools of lamp glow; -a has a warm oblique key light, so one side is lit and shadows fall long, dark and soft to the lower left, giving a muted, moody tone -b replaces with a bright toy-like one
issues.fix: move the key light high and to one side, warm it, and let the shadows run long and soft down-left; darken and desaturate the overall exposure toward -a

issues.where: the 'a steel ball' crop (also the rolling balls in set-C-03-b.png)
issues.what: the balls are smoky translucent glass marbles with an internal swirl; -a has opaque mirror-chrome steel balls with sharp reflections of the playfield
issues.fix: make the balls solid polished steel with crisp environment reflections

issues.what: the cursor inside the glass ball reads as a crumpled 3D shard, like a paper plane; -a holds a flat, crisp pointer arrow with a dark edge and a glossy face
issues.fix: rebuild the cursor as a flat white arrow lying flat in the ball, with a thin dark outline and a glossy top face

issues.where: the 'the cubicles' crop, upper left of the playfield
issues.what: -b draws them as a solid beige block with the desks printed flat on its top face; -a has real open cubicle compartments with low walls, gaps between them, and tiny desks sitting inside
issues.fix: model open three-walled compartments with visible wall thickness and interior depth, desks recessed inside

issues.what: -b's bumpers are dark glossy rings with a flat glowing dome; -a's bumpers are white ceramic caps on warm copper bodies with a bright metal skirt at the base, and the copper wrap is gone in -b
issues.fix: restore the white cap over a warm copper drum with a metal skirt ring

issues.what: -b's floor is a coarse, bright green carpet grain with tan felt strips; -a's floor is a smooth, muted slate-teal with a fine speckle, and -b also adds heavy clutter piles of papers and rings in the lower corners that -a does not have
issues.fix: darken and desaturate the floor toward slate teal, tighten the grain to a fine speckle, and thin the scattered clutter to the few paper clips and envelopes in -a

issues.what: -b's slingshots are plain glossy red wedges; -a's are red office staplers with hinge line, chrome base plate and screws, and the stapler identity is lost in -b
issues.fix: give the slingshot the stapler body: hinge seam along the top, a metal base plate and fasteners

issues.where: the 'the bend of the tube' crop, upper left
issues.what: -b renders the elbow of the lift tube as orange-amber plastic; -a renders it as chromed metal like the rest of the tube
issues.fix: chrome the elbow to match the tube, keeping the orange only for the doors
